story_type: injured sailor hoisted off the sail of a surfaced submarine far offshore, infrared camera
hook: The only place to land this basket: a submarine's tower.
narration: This rescue basket had one place to land. The top of a submarine.
A twenty two year old Navy sailor was hurt aboard, a hundred and sixty miles west of San Diego.
A Coast Guard aircrew flew out and tracked the sub on its infrared camera.
A surfaced submarine rides low, with waves washing over its hull. The sail on top is the only dry place to stand.
[short pause] The crew on the sail got ready as the helicopter moved in.
outcome: The sailor was flown to San Diego and handed to emergency medical crews.

location_card.place: 160 miles west of San Diego, California

title: Hoisted off a submarine at sea
description:
On Oct. 11, 2013, a Coast Guard Sector San Diego aircrew approached a surfaced submarine about 160 miles west of San Diego to medevac an injured 22-year-old Navy sailor, and flew him to San Diego for further care.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector San Diego, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/303274
